name: Floating shelf over the bed with 2 split reading lights
description: Oak floating shelf (decorations on top) with a divider fin hanging under its middle; a warm LED spot on each face of the fin, tilted out to its own side of the bed and a bit into the room, so each side's light stays on that side (each its own switch). Cable through the fin to the wall, in a white cover down to behind the headboard. Origin: back-centre at the bottom of the shelf board (hang with elevation).

source.notes: Self-built / generic floating shelf + 2 small LED spots; not a specific product.

divider.description: cm the divider fin hangs below the shelf

tilt.description: degrees each light turns out to its side

lean.description: degrees each light turns into the room

cableDrop.description: cm of cable cover down the wall
